header.running_head: 3. Belief in the Events after Death...

blocks.tamil_translation: they will be; they will see therein neither heat nor bitter cold. Its (trees') shades will be close over them, and its fruits will hang very low. Vessels of silver and goblets of crystal will be passed (round and) round among them. (They will be) crystal made of silver, which they will have measured out in due measure. And there they will be given (a drink) to drink from a cup whose mixture will be ginger. (They will be given it) from a spring there, which is called Salsabil (its water goes down without difficulty, and it is sweet). Boys who remain forever (without losing their youth) will go around them; (O Prophet,) when you see them you would think them scattered pearls. (And) when you look there, you will see bliss and a great kingdom. Upon them will be garments of fine silk and of green thick silk; and they will be adorned with bracelets of silver; and their Rabb will give them a pure drink. “Indeed this is your reward; your effort in the world has been accepted” (He will also say).

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَأَصْحبُ الْيَمِينِ لا مَا أَصْحبُ الْيَمِين ِ۞ فِي سِدْرٍ مَّخْضُودٍ۞ وَّطَلْحٍ مَّنْضُودٍ ۞ وَّظِلٍّ مَّمْدُودٍ ۞ وَّمَاءٍ مَّسْكُوبٍ ۞ وَّفَاكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ ۞ لَّا مَقْطُوعَةٍ وَّلَا مَمْنُوعَةٍ ۞ وَّفُرُشٍ مَّرْفُوعَةٍ ۞ إِنَّا أَنْشَأْنهُنَّ إِنْشَآءً ۞ فَجَعَلْنهُنَّ أَبْكَارًا ۞ عُرُباً أَتْرَاباً ۞ لِّأَصْحبِ الْيَمِينِ ۞ ثُلَّةٌ مِّنَ اْلاَوَّلِينَ ۞ وَثُلَّةٌ مِّنَ اْلآخِرِينَ۞).
